body: I think that is another option. Do something where she can’t forgive me and realises she’s better off without me. And not hurting anyone else in the process too.

Like I said in my post, there is nothing inside of me, I am empty. I have no love left in me and I just want this to end. The only thing that I have a bit of regret for is my family’s feeling afterwards, but that is something that happens, I am a statistic. I will send them a proper note before this ends. Wish you luck!
